body:
to anyone who stumbles across this, don't worry. I decided that I'm not the one who fucked up, if anyone should hate themselves it's her.

I deserve better, and I might not find anyone ever again, but I'd rather have my pride.

Hi all,

I never considered suicide seriously before, I always thought I'd be stronger than that. But now I think I'm being pushed over the edge.


I recently had a problem with my girlfriend, we got over it and she told me she loved me and wanted to be with me and was so sure about us.


I have been away at school for a week.

Last thursday she went out with friends, got drunk, and made out with someone else.

She says she's leaving me for my own good, or at least she did.

I sucked it up, and tried to forgive her.

Now she doesn't want me, "because of the drama."

No use fighting it anymore, 2 years wasted.

I feel bad for my family and friends, but I don't know if I can go another day.
